name: 80年代 City Pop 插画
art: 1980s Japanese city-pop record-sleeve illustration: smooth airbrush gradients, clean flat graphic shapes, crisp hard-edged shadows, a cool pastel palette of pale blue, pink and mint, very tidy and stylish, lots of empty sky.

name: C2：改侧光（午后侧光、明暗分明）
name_en: the signature style of one specific (fictional) illustrator, C
art: C's signature look: refined and airy; crisp clean silhouettes; fine thin lines only where forms overlap; every form slightly stylised with softly rounded corners, including the architecture; a pastel palette; smooth, noise-free, polished finish; a characteristic sky fading from clear cyan at the top through a narrow band of peach toward the horizon. Lighting: warm afternoon sunlight from the side instead of from behind; sunlit faces of the buildings are pale and warm, shaded faces are cool blue-grey with readable detail, and the boundary between them is clean and crisp; a soft glow only along the edges that catch the sun; the sky stays a clear cyan, never blown out to white.
